name: PSYCHO-BABBLE!
author: Corey and Bell
bootlegger: All Minions are Psychopaths. Psychopaths can only kill after private chats have ended and before nominations have begun. All deaths happen during the day. The Pacifist has changed.

name: Pacifist
ability: Nominated and executed good players are prompted to play roshambo. They only die if they lose.
flavor: Distrust all in whom the impulse to punish is powerful.

name: Psychopath
ability: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.

name: YaggaMadness
ability: Each night, the demon chooses a player: they are "mad" they are the Psychopath tomorrow, or might be executed.
flavor: The defendant pleads innocent on account of temporary insanity.
firstNightReminder:
Wake the Lunatic up. The Lunatic chooses a player. Put the Lunatic to sleep.

Wake the Yaggababble up. Show them the Lunatic token, then the player with the Lunatic *chosen* reminder token. The Yaggababble chooses a player. Put the Yaggababble to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Yaggababble token, then the YaggaMadness token.
otherNightReminder:
